recorded.prompt:q-variables: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-variables: "A diff of the start variables would see P008 lose x_P008,2031 and gain x_P008,2029, two changes, where a planner sees one: P008 moved two years earlier."
recorded.prompt:q-order: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-order: "Each is the cost of one change given the other". Also: "'The override costs $205k' is true after the cut and false before it."
recorded.prompt:q-tie: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-tie: Heading: 'A Diff Worth a Few Thousand Is a Near Tie, Not a Decision'; 'diff is worth 0.033% of the plan have made the same decision with a coin toss on the details'. 0.02% within a 0.5% gap is the same case.

recorded.prompt:q-variables:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-variables:a: The same passage gives the variable diff two changes (a drop and an add) and the project diff one move. Option a has them reversed.
recorded.prompt:q-variables:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-variables:c: The same passage: the variable diff sees "two changes", not none.
recorded.prompt:q-variables:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-variables:d: The same passage: the variable diff sees two changes, and the project diff reports a shift ("shifted ... a(i) != b(i)").
recorded.prompt:q-order:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-order:a: "Neither number is wrong. Each is the cost of one change given the other". The base figure is not privileged.
recorded.prompt:q-order:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-order:b: "Add step costs only along one path." $90k (after the cut) and $140k (on the base) are not on one path.
recorded.prompt:q-order:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-order:c: "Neither number is wrong ... State the order with every attribution." The cost is the conditional figures, not their difference.
recorded.prompt:q-tie:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-tie:b: 'A solve allowed to stop at a relative gap of 0.1% has no such duty... it may stop at either' plan, so differing plans are expected, not a bug.
recorded.prompt:q-tie:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-tie:c: 'a diff between two such runs could show P018 and P029 moving with nothing in the inputs changed'. Design Note blames 'the run itself (settings, versions, ties)', not the model.
recorded.prompt:q-tie:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-tie:d: 'A diff worth a few thousand is a near tie, not a decision'. Only a diff worth around 5% means 'different decisions'.
